description: One way: its kind and every kind it is the best of, its points between the ends (fixes, points of the pilot's own, fuel stops), the fuel stops among them and those with somewhere to eat, its path, distance, minutes in the air and on the ground (30 a landing), fuel, landings, the hazards it crosses and the marginal ones it passes (indices into hazards), and what it meets. With no airplane (a null profile) its minutes in the air and its fuel are null, and it has no fuel stops.
title: RouteOption

crosses.description: The hazards it crosses, indices into hazards, in the order flown: what closes a cell, and the restricted, MOA, warning and alert areas it is flown through.

warning.description: The card's one warning, the worst it crosses, in the engine's words: a prohibited area or a TFR (14 CFR 91.133(a), 91.137 to 91.145), a restricted area (91.133(a), AIM 3-4-3), storms, high ground, a SIGMET, no fuel stop in reach, other weather, then a warning area, a MOA and an alert area (AIM 3-4-4 to 3-4-6) -- "Crosses a restricted area", "Crosses a MOA" ...; null where it crosses nothing.
